title: Head Chef
experience: Has significant experience leading professional kitchen teams
description_text:
Our client is one of Malta’s leading premium steakhouse restaurants, renowned for exceptional meats, fine wines, and genuine hospitality. They are committed to delivering outstanding dining experiences through quality, consistency, and a passion for excellence. They are looking for talented hospitality professionals who share their commitment to high standards.
 Position Summary
 Our client is seeking an experienced and passionate Head Chef to lead their kitchen team. The successful candidate will be responsible for overseeing all kitchen operations, ensuring the highest standards of food quality, consistency, hygiene, and service while creating a positive and professional kitchen environment.
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead, manage, and motivate the kitchen team to deliver exceptional food quality and service.
 Oversee daily kitchen operations, ensuring smooth and efficient workflow.
 Develop and maintain high standards of food preparation, presentation, and consistency.
 Create and maintain menus that reflect Mediterranean and Italian culinary traditions.
 Ensure the highest standards of food safety, hygiene, and kitchen cleanliness.
 Manage food costs, stock control, and ordering processes effectively.
 Train, mentor, and develop kitchen team members.
 Establish and maintain a strong kitchen culture based on teamwork, discipline, and excellence.
 Work closely with the management team to achieve operational and business objectives.
 Monitor kitchen performance and implement improvements where required.
 Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations.
 Requirements
 Has significant experience leading professional kitchen teams.
 Has a strong background in Mediterranean and Italian cuisine, with Sicilian culinary experience highly valued.
 Demonstrates excellent leadership, organisation, and communication skills.
 Maintains the highest standards of food quality, hygiene, and consistency.
 Has a positive attitude and a passion for developing a strong kitchen culture.
 Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, premium dining environment.
 Strong attention to detail and commitment to culinary excellence.
 What We Offer
 Opportunity to lead the kitchen team of one of Malta’s leading premium steakhouse restaurants.
 Professional and supportive working environment.
 The opportunity to work with high-quality ingredients and create exceptional dining experiences.
 Career growth and development opportunities.
 Competitive remuneration package based on experience.
 Join Our Client's Team
 If you are a passionate culinary professional with strong leadership skills and a dedication to excellence, we would love to hear from you. Apply today and take the next step in your culinary career.
